next_steps: Two findings remain recorded but deliberately unfixed, both in .audit/ with evidence. (1) lib/booking/store.ts:217 calls dispatch during render, which reaches saveDraft -> sessionStorage.setItem; it is a genuine impurity but no test could be built to discriminate it (two attempts both passed on the old code because preselected === service disarms the write after the first commit), and moving the write into an effect regressed app/admin/bookings/__tests__/calendar.test.tsx from 4.5s to a 20s+ timeout across three consecutive runs, because main commits draft.date synchronously during render and the calendar depends on that. Revisit only if a real discarded render appears on the booking page. The audit probes now live in frontend/.audit-probes/ and run with: node frontend/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root frontend .audit-probes. The default suite does not collect them (verified 0).
